basis: World-frame marker-center error plus (R_est-R_truth) times the marker-to-grasp lever. The signed pair difference is ID 7 minus ID 8. Scalar contributions project onto the measured pair vector.

comparison_operators.angle: Principal SO(3) angle. Yaw is the signed world-Z heading of marker x.
comparison_operators.corner_rms: RMS Euclidean pixel error for the four ordered corners.
comparison_operators.time: Previous usable same ID, with gap length. Per-step comparisons match the stage and retain the individual placement.

factors.both_true: Projected corners and exact true-plane depth. The fifth site still uses the mean of projected corners, as in the recorded estimator.
factors.contrast: Depth-first vectors are observed minus true_depth, then true_depth minus both_true. Corners-first vectors are observed minus true_corners, then true_corners minus both_true. Interaction is observed - true_depth - true_corners + both_true. These are conditional vector differences.
factors.observed: Detected ordered corners and mean corner pixel, with archived 3x3 median optical-z at each site.
factors.raw_depth_residual: Raw optical-z minus projected plane optical-z at each integer pixel center, in mm. A negative value is nearer. Geometry identity is unconstrained.
factors.true_corners: Projected ordered true corners with a fresh sample of the archived depth at each new rounded 3x3 footprint.
factors.true_depth: Same detected corners with exact optical-z where the continuous ray intersects the registered printed plane.

indexing: One row per consumed /feedback image, including the rejection before its Shield clock. Same-step terminal, PRE, POST and servo reference images have other roles. Command sequence comes from that stage's PRE binding. Accepted feedback also matches its own clock.
scope: Retrospective frozen feedback. All substitutions use saved images and state.
substitution_gates: All four target vectors retain the unconstrained geometric estimate to evaluate two-factor interaction. variant_metric_valid_ids identifies which marker estimates pass the original per-marker geometric checks under each archived-frame substitution.
